title: Publish the public memory technology survey and 2026-2032 roadmap
instruction: Research DDR, LPDDR, HBM, SOCAMM, 3D-stacked DRAM, wafer-to-wafer bonding, die-to-wafer bonding, TSV, co-packaged optics, CXL, and PIM using public sources and publish a bilingual technology summary and vendor-specific 2026-2032 timeline on GitHub Pages. Distinguish commercial shipment, samples, standards, vendor targets, concepts, and dates that were not publicly disclosed. Keep the result explicitly provisional until independent-model Consensus is completed, and publish no NDA or private information.
